router.algorithm: router.ts routeRequest(): score = sum of weights (phrase 3, token length>=5 2, else 1) for every index word that is a substring of the lowercased input; highest total wins, ties to registry order; fallback id "intent".

probeCorpus.definition: every distinct index token as a standalone input, plus each agent's full sorted word set as one input

collisionProbes.input: find the latest news and verify the facts

canonicalProbes.input: what are prayer times in London?
